message: Field "Place.location" has type "Unsupported(...)", which has no Prisma 8 codec, so model "Place" cannot use this contract source while it has the field. Prisma 6 rejects @ignore on an Unsupported field. Removing the field from the schema leaves its stored values in the documents, but the Prisma 6 client no longer reads or writes them. Adding @@ignore to model "Place" keeps the model out of the contract, but the model disappears from the Prisma 6 client too, and every relation field in another model that points to it needs @ignore, which removes that field from the Prisma 6 client as well.
